siteWeek.title: Working week of the sites
siteWeek.intro: Weekly rest days of every site, or of a site that sets its own, from a date. Capacity counts them as non-working days, except for continuous Classes horaires (3×8, 24/7).
siteWeek.formTitle: Weekly rest days from a date
siteWeek.formDescription: Applies from the date you choose (today or later); earlier weeks keep their rest days.

impact.title: Planned work orders use this version
impact.description: {{count}} open work order(s) are planned on this version ({{codes}}). They keep the hours they were planned with and will show that the timetable changed since planning.

editor.title: Classe horaire — {{name}}
editor.description: Shift pattern of the teams and people linked to this Classe horaire. A change applies from a date and never rewrites past capacity.
editor.noVersion: This Classe horaire has no timetable yet: teams linked to it have no capacity. Describe it below.
editor.effectiveFromHelp: Today or later: capacity and plans before this date stay as they are.
editor.utilisationHelp: Share of shift time available for work orders (the rest goes to meetings, travel, breaks not counted, admin). Between 1 and 100 %; 85 % is a common starting point.
editor.continuousHelp: The crew works through the site's weekly rest days and public holidays, following only this cycle.
editor.rotationStart: Day 1 of the rotation falls on
editor.plannableHoursCycle: Hours for work orders per cycle
editor.siteRestWarning: Some working days fall on the site's weekly rest days ({{days}}): they count only for continuous Classes horaires or for sites with another working week.
editor.readOnly: You can view this Classe horaire; changing it needs the reference data management permission.

issues.cycleLength: Describe each day of the cycle (1 to 56 days).
issues.rotationStart: Give the date on which day 1 of the rotation falls.
issues.time: Enter every working day's start and end time.
issues.breakTooLong: A break must be shorter than its shift.
issues.noWorkingDay: Keep at least one working day.
issues.utilisation: Enter the utilisation factor, between 1 and 100 %.
issues.date: Choose today or a later date.

review.classTitle: Created by the update — please review
review.classBody: This Classe horaire was set up by the update at 100 % utilisation: set its utilisation factor (share of shift time available for work orders) now. One built from a team's former capacity rule shares that rule's hours among the team's members of the time (see its note). Confirm it as is, or save a new version from today.
review.teamTitle: Default built from the team's former capacity rule — please review
review.teamBody: The update kept this team's capacity rule as the Classe horaire “{{name}}”. It now applies to each member who has no Classe horaire of their own. Confirm it, or choose the right default from a date (or none).

team.title: Classes horaires
team.inheritHint: The team's capacity is the sum of its members' Classes horaires. The default below applies only to members who have none of their own (set on their sheet) and no dated exception.
team.noClasses: No Classe horaire has a timetable yet: set one up in Reference data → Classes horaires.
team.noDefault: No default Classe horaire: each member counts their own Classe horaire.
team.withoutBody: They count 0 h: no hours are ever assumed. Give each one a Classe horaire on their sheet, or set a default for the team below.
team.withoutAllBody: No member has a Classe horaire, so the team has 0 h and planning cannot book work for it. Give each member a Classe horaire on their sheet, or set a default for the team below.

exceptions.title: Timetable exceptions
exceptions.intro: Another Classe horaire than the team's, or part time, over a period. Absences (leave, training, sickness) are recorded below.
exceptions.empty: No exception: this person follows the team's Classe horaire.
exceptions.formHint: From today or later; past capacity is never rewritten.
exceptions.endHint: This exception has started: you can only set its end date (today or later).
exceptions.percentHelp: Share of the timetable worked, e.g. 50 for half time. Leave empty for full time.
exceptions.reasonHelp: Personal data: shown only to people allowed to see it.

overtimeCeiling.title: Overtime ceiling
overtimeCeiling.hint: Hours planning may add each day on top of the crew members' timetables. A rule applies from a day, until a day or with no end; periods never overlap.
overtimeCeiling.none: No ceiling: planning adds no overtime for this crew.
